newsitem.title: USA: Weekly jobless claims up in latest week.
newsitem.headline: Weekly jobless claims up in latest week.

text.p: The number of Americans filing for first-time jobless benefits rose last week, the government said Thursday.
The Labour Department said weekly jobless claims rose to 347,000 in the week ended June 14. Claims stood at 339,000 the week before.
Wall Street economists surveyed by Reuters had expected 333,000 claims. The level of claims last week was the highest since the week ended May 3, the department said.
The four-week moving average of claims, seen as a more reliable indicator of jobless trends than the more-volatile weekly figure, jumped to 335,500 from 329,250 the previous week.

A total of 2,295,000 people continued to file claims for unemployment benefits in the week ended June 7, the latest period for which the data were available, the department said. That was up from a revised 2,274,000 the week before.
